metrics.name: Twin Store State
metrics.description: Latest recorded opened/closed operation at or before UTC current time for one selected store; returns not observed with no source evidence and BLANK for ties or multi-store context.

metrics.name: Twin Store State As Of
metrics.description: Timestamp of the latest recorded store operation event at or before UTC current time for one selected store in the current filter context.

metrics.name: Twin Store Signed Stock
metrics.description: Signed sum of known store/product current balances; negative balances are retained and missing balances remain BLANK.

metrics.name: Twin Store Available Stock
metrics.description: Sum of max(0, known balance) at store/SKU grain without fabricating missing SKU balances.

metrics.name: Twin Store Inventory As Of
metrics.description: Conservative timestamp for in-context store inventory: the oldest source as-of among known store/SKU balances.

metrics.name: Twin Store Stockout Risk
metrics.description: Maximum recorded stockout probability in the current store/product context; no fixed horizon is imposed.

metrics.name: Twin Store Zone Activity
metrics.description: Observed foot-traffic activity count from sensor-zone events; not occupancy and not unique people.

metrics.name: Twin Warehouse Signed Stock
metrics.description: Signed sum of known DC/product current balances; negative balances are retained and missing balances remain BLANK.

metrics.name: Twin Warehouse Available Stock
metrics.description: Sum of max(0, known balance) at DC/SKU grain; reservations and available-to-promise are not modeled.

metrics.name: Twin Warehouse Inventory As Of
metrics.description: Conservative timestamp for in-context warehouse inventory: the oldest source as-of among known DC/SKU balances.

metrics.name: Twin Warehouse Shipment Count
metrics.description: Distinct source-recorded shipments in the trailing 14 days ending at the latest recorded truck-move timestamp at or before UTC current time in context; preserves Store/DC filters.

metrics.name: Twin Truck Last Status
metrics.description: Latest recorded truck status at or before UTC current time for one selected truck; returns not observed with no source evidence and BLANK for ties or multi-truck context.

metrics.name: Twin Truck State As Of
metrics.description: Timestamp of the latest recorded truck-move event at or before UTC current time for one selected truck in the current source-grounded Store/DC filter context.

metrics.name: Twin Truck Last Shipment
metrics.description: Shipment ID from the single latest recorded truck-move row at or before UTC current time for one selected truck; ties or no evidence return BLANK.

metrics.name: Twin Truck Last Store
metrics.description: Store ID from the single latest recorded truck-move row at or before UTC current time for one selected truck; ties or no evidence return BLANK.

metrics.name: Twin Truck Last DC
metrics.description: Distribution center ID from the single latest recorded truck-move row at or before UTC current time for one selected truck; ties or no evidence return BLANK.

metrics.name: Twin Truck Recorded ETA
metrics.description: Recorded planned ETA from the single latest observed truck-move row for one selected truck; value may be future and is never scenario-adjusted.

metrics.name: Twin Truck Recorded ETD
metrics.description: Recorded planned ETD from the single latest observed truck-move row for one selected truck; value may be future and is never scenario-adjusted.

metrics.name: Twin Truck Cargo Balance
metrics.description: Observed net cargo at or before UTC current time for the latest source-recorded truck/shipment pair using source action semantics: LOAD adds quantity and UNLOAD removes quantity.

metrics.name: Twin Truck Cargo As Of
metrics.description: Latest observed cargo event timestamp at or before UTC current time for the latest source-recorded truck/shipment pair; product filters preserve source evidence.

metrics.name: Twin Truck Delay Scenario ETA
metrics.description: What-if ETA equal to recorded ETA plus 60 minutes; actual recorded ETA is not overwritten.

metrics.name: Twin Truck Delay Minutes
metrics.description: What-if delay amount. Returns 60 only when source evidence includes a recorded ETA.
